system.description:
These tall icon-bearing shields accompany religious processions but are equally capable of stopping arrows. You may spend 2 AP to plant the shield securely. While planted, it cannot provide you with its normal shield benefits, but it functions as a small portable shrine or ceremonial surface. Appropriate use grants a +1-item bonus to Perform Last Rites or Observe Sacred Custom.

On the sheet: +1 item is offered on Perform Last Rites and Observe Sacred Custom — tick while the shield is planted (its DB is yours to unequip meanwhile).

Pillars of Faith, Chapter 6.

conditionals.label: Processional Aegis
conditionals.scope: Perform Last Rites or Observe Sacred Custom while the shield is planted (2 AP; no shield benefits meanwhile)
